review.assessment: The change centralizes all entitlement checks into `model.is_entitled()` and applies it across all four consumers (`access.py`, `digest.py`, `seats.py`, `support.py`). This replaces the stale `ENTITLED_STATUSES` tuple with a date-aware check that correctly treats lapsed trials as unentitled, matching the rule in `docs/trials.md`. Structural, acceptance (7/7), and veto checks all pass without issues.
